name: Pixel Stretch
description: A line sweeps across the frame and drags the pixels of the first clip behind it as long streaks, which shorten as it goes and reveal the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the line sweeps (x right, y up)

params.name: stretch
params.description: Length of the streaks at the middle of the sweep, as a part of the frame

params.name: chroma
params.description: Amount of RGB split along the streaks

params.name: softness
params.description: Softness of the line and of the streaks' ends

params.name: jitter
params.description: How much the streaks jitter, each row at its own length
